description: This Java configuration class sets up a batch job within the Apache Fineract project to add periodic accrual entries for loans, specifically when income has been posted as transactions. It defines beans for the job, its step, and a tasklet that performs the core process.

classes.name: AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesForLoansConfig
classes.description: Java configuration class for setting up batch jobs related to loan accruals in Fineract.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccrualEntriesForLoansWithIncomePostedAsTransactionsStep
methods.description: Defines the batch step that executes the tasklet for adding periodic accrual entries.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccrualEntriesForLoansWithIncomePostedAsTransactionsJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that includes the step for processing loan accruals.

methods.name: addPeriodicAccrualEntriesForLoansWithIncomePostedAsTransactionsTasklet
methods.description: Creates and returns the tasklet responsible for performing the accrual entries addition process.
